visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens on a cardboard cat house decorated like a traditional Chinese temple in pink and yellow. A tiny black-and-white kitten's paw and then its face poke through a small circular hole at the front. The lighting is bright and indoor-focused. (2) An adult orange-and-white cat jumps onto a soft grey and pink cushion next to the cardboard house, causing the structure to shift slightly. (3) The camera performs a digital zoom on the kitten's face. The kitten has its small pink tongue sticking out, staring directly into the lens with large, curious eyes. It rests its chin on the edge of the cardboard hole. (4) The orange cat is shown sitting on the cushion, looking off to the side with a calm, neutral expression. (5) The kitten's white-tipped paw reaches out of the cardboard house again, batting at the air. (6) The cardboard cat house suddenly tilts and falls forward onto the bed. The black-and-white kitten is seen scurrying out from behind the collapsing structure on a pink surface as the orange cat watches from its perch.
